name: Cable Single-Arm Rear Delt Row
steps: Sit at a cable row station with your feet braced and reach forward for its handle with one hand.
Draw the handle toward your upper ribs with your elbow traveling out to the side.
Reach forward again until your arm extends.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your torso facing the machine as you pull.
Keep your shoulder down away from your ear and lead with your elbow wide.
